rt1_end_date_merge.detail: all joins use ann_date<=T; report_period only used to index versions

rt2_update_flag_backfill.detail: update_flag only a tie-break within same ann_date; latest_leq enforces ann_date<=T

rt3_forward_fill_across_announcements.detail: no ffill across announcement dates; each signal date re-selects as-of version

rt4_current_sector_backfill.detail: sector built from index_member in/out dates only; stock_basic.industry never used for membership

rt5_future_delist_st_industry.detail: no future delist/ST/industry-change info used; membership intervals only from historical in/out

rt6_ttm_future_quarters.detail: TTM uses cum(P,Y), cum(P,Y-1), cum(Q4,Y-1) each selected with ann_date<=T

rt7_forecast_express_post_pub.detail: forecast selected with ann_date<=T; express flag requires ann_date<=T and end_date<=T
